questions.q: The marketing team will ------- a new advertising campaign next month.
questions.why: will のあとは動詞の原形。launch は「(事業・キャンペーンを)始める」。

questions.q: Ms. Tanaka was ------- to the position of regional manager last week.
questions.why: was のあとで「昇進させられた」という受け身。be promoted to ～ =「～に昇進する」。

questions.q: All employees must submit their expense reports ------- Friday.
questions.why: 「金曜日までに」という期限は by。during は期間、since は起点、between は2点の間。

questions.q: The new software is ------- easier to use than the previous version.
questions.why: 比較級 easier を強めるのは much（ほか far, even, still, a lot）。very は原級に使う。

questions.q: Please contact the HR department if you have any ------- about your benefits.
questions.why: any のあとは名詞。questions（質問）が入る。

questions.q: ------- the heavy rain, the outdoor concert took place as scheduled.
questions.why: 後ろが名詞句（the heavy rain）なので前置詞の Despite。Although/Because は後ろに節が必要。

questions.q: Mr. Park is responsible for ------- all incoming shipments.
questions.why: 前置詞 for のあとは動名詞。be responsible for -ing =「～を担当している」。

questions.q: The conference room is ------- for the use of senior staff only.
questions.why: be 動詞のあとで「予約されている」という受け身。reserved for ～ =「～専用の」。

questions.q: Our company offers ------- prices on bulk orders.
questions.why: 名詞 prices を修飾する形容詞。competitive prices =「他社に負けない価格」。

questions.q: The ------- of the new branch will take place on October 5.
questions.why: 冠詞 the のあとは名詞。opening =「開店・開設」。the opening of ～ で「～の開業」。

questions.q: Neither the manager nor the assistants ------- aware of the schedule change.
questions.why: Neither A nor B の動詞は B（the assistants=複数）に合わせる。過去の話なので were。

questions.q: The report must be reviewed ------- before it is sent to the client.
questions.why: 受け身 be reviewed を修飾するのは副詞。thoroughly =「徹底的に」。

questions.q: We will announce the winner ------- the contest ends.
questions.why: 「コンテストが終わり次第」。as soon as は接続詞で、時を表す節では現在形（ends）を使う。

questions.q: The CEO asked ------- to prepare a presentation for the board meeting.
questions.why: ask の目的語になる目的格は us。ask 人 to 動詞 =「人に～するよう頼む」。

questions.q: Delivery will be delayed ------- a shortage of drivers.
questions.why: 原因を表す前置詞は due to（～のせいで）。in spite of は「～にもかかわらず」で意味が合わない。

questions.q: The company plans to ------- its operations to Southeast Asia next year.
questions.why: expand =「拡大する」。expend は「費やす」、expire は「期限が切れる」、express は「表現する」。

questions.q: The hotel offers a ------- breakfast to all guests.
questions.why: complimentary =「無料の」。名詞 breakfast を修飾する形容詞。

questions.q: Ms. Reyes has worked at the firm ------- more than ten years.
questions.why: 現在完了で「～年間」と期間の長さを言うときは for。since は起点（年・月日）を取る。

questions.q: The brochure was designed to ------- potential customers.
questions.why: to のあとは動詞の原形。attract =「引きつける」。

questions.q: Visitors may enter the building through ------- the main entrance or the side door.
questions.why: either A or B =「AかBのどちらか」。both は and と、neither は nor と組む。

questions.q: The restaurant, ------- opened last month, has already received excellent reviews.
questions.why: 先行詞は the restaurant（物）で、後ろに主語がないので主格の which。

questions.q: We need to hire someone ------- skills include fluency in Spanish.
questions.why: someone's skills の関係なので所有格の whose。

questions.q: Mr. Okada is ------- of the three candidates for the sales director position.
questions.why: 3人の中で「最も」なので、the + 最上級。of the three が最上級のサイン。

questions.q: The lecture was so ------- that many attendees left early.
questions.why: 主語が「物（講義）」で「退屈な」という性質なので boring。bored は人の気持ちに使う。

questions.q: The factory's output has ------- increased since the new machines were installed.
questions.why: has increased（動詞）を修飾する副詞。steadily =「着実に」。

questions.q: Customers can ------- their orders online at any time.
questions.why: 助動詞 can のあとは動詞の原形。track =「追跡する」。

questions.q: The firm's profits rose ------- 12 percent last quarter.
questions.why: 増減の差・幅を表すときは by。rose by 12 percent =「12%上昇した」。

questions.q: Please ------- the enclosed form and return it by mail.
questions.why: complete a form =「用紙に記入する」。似た綴りの語（compete 競争する、complement 補う、compliment ほめる）に注意。

questions.q: The seminar will not begin ------- all participants have registered.
questions.why: not ... until ～ =「～するまで…しない」。

questions.q: ------- you need further assistance, please call our help desk.
questions.why: If you should need の if を省いた倒置。Should you need ～ =「万一必要でしたら」。
will be のあとなので過去分詞。the move will be completed =「引っ越しは完了する予定」。
boxes を後ろから修飾する過去分詞。「施設チームによって提供された箱」。

c: Our current lease ends in June.
The new building has a large cafeteria.
Please write your name and new desk number on each box.
Several employees have asked about the schedule.
questions.why: 直前は荷造りの指示、直後は「割れ物は目立つよう表示を」。荷造りの指示の続きになる「名前と新しい机の番号を箱に書く」が自然。
permits は配られる側なので受け身。starting next week から未来なので will be distributed。
stop -ing =「～するのをやめる（動かなくなる）」。stop to work だと「働くために立ち止まる」で意味が違う。
助動詞 will のあとは動詞の原形。

c: Our stores are open until nine o'clock.
Please use the label to return the defective unit.
Blenders are available in four colors.
We have recently changed our logo.
questions.why: 次の文の「送料前払いのラベルをメールで送る」につながるのは、そのラベルで不良品を返送してほしいという文。
once（～したら）が作る時の節では、未来のことも現在形で表す。
「日曜日も」開館するので also。will also be open。
調査の結果が出た「あとで」変更になった。after が自然。

c: The additional hours were requested by many local students.
Library cards are free for all city residents.
The library was founded more than a century ago.
Parking is prohibited behind the building.
questions.why: 直前が開館時間の変更、直後が In addition（さらに）で別の変更。開館時間の話を続ける「追加の時間は多くの地元の学生に求められていた」が合う。
at a time =「一度に」。for up to two hours at a time =「一度に最長2時間」。
to のあとは動詞の原形。inform 人 that ～ =「人に～と知らせる」。
グラフィックデザイナーの面接で持参するのは portfolio（作品集）。

c: We have received more than 200 applications this year.
Our office is closed on national holidays.
The Dalton Building was constructed in 1998.
You will meet with the art director and two members of the design team.
questions.why: 次の文の「この面談は約1時間」の「面談」の中身を説明する「美術部長とデザインチームの2名と会う」が自然。
be unable to ～ =「～できない」。impossible は人を主語にできない。

questions.why: 出席できないので、会議を水曜に移せないかと頼んでいる。

questions.q: What is included with the e-mail?

It can be combined with other promotions.
questions.why: Join ... before April 30 と、他の特典とは併用できない（cannot be combined）とある。

questions.q: Who is eligible for an additional discount?
questions.why: corporate partnership のある地元企業の従業員が、追加10%引き。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the article?
c: To announce a new business location
questions.why: 2店舗目の開店を発表する記事。

questions.q: What is mentioned about the new shop?
c: It will be on Main Street.
It will be larger than the original.
questions.why: three times larger than the original（元の店の3倍の広さ）。場所は Eastgate、開店は8月15日。

c: The bakery will apply for a loan.
A café menu will be announced.

c: He does not want to cancel the training.
He does not want to pay extra for earlier delivery.

questions.q: What will Ms. Park most likely do next?
c: Call the catering company to cancel
Inform participants of the schedule change

questions.q: What will happen if the customer pays after the due date?

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?

questions.q: What will happen if a report is submitted late?

Reimbursement will be delayed until the next cycle.

docs.label: Article
docs.text:
Millbrook Bakery to Open Second Location

Millbrook Bakery, a family-owned business famous for its sourdough bread, will open a second location in the Eastgate shopping district on August 15, owner Lina Hassan announced Monday. The new shop will be three times larger than the original on Main Street and will include a café with seating for forty customers. Ms. Hassan said the expansion was made possible by a loan from the city's Small Business Fund. "Our customers have asked for more space for years," she said. The company plans to hire twelve new employees, and interviews will begin next month. The Main Street shop will remain open with its current hours.

docs.text:
MEMO
To: All Sales Staff
From: Rita Gomez, Vice President of Sales
Date: November 4
Re: Travel Expense Policy

Effective January 1, the company will change how travel expenses are reported. Currently, employees submit paper receipts to the Accounting Department at the end of each trip. Under the new system, receipts must be photographed and uploaded through the Expense Tracker app within ten days of the trip. Reports that are submitted late will not be reimbursed until the following month's payment cycle.

Air travel must still be booked through the company's travel agency, Skyline Travel, but employees may now choose their own hotels as long as the nightly rate does not exceed $180.

Training sessions on the Expense Tracker app will be held on December 3 and December 10 in the main conference room. Attendance is strongly encouraged. Questions should be directed to Henry Doyle in Accounting.

docs.label: Customer review
docs.text:
3 out of 5 stars — Good device, difficult setup
Posted by Paul K., September 12

I bought the Vista thermostat hoping to lower my winter heating bills. The thermostat itself looks great and the app is easy to use. However, installation took me more than two hours because my old system did not have a common wire, which the instructions barely mention. I had to hire an electrician for $90. Once it was working, it did a good job of learning my schedule. I would recommend it, but only if you are comfortable with wiring or have help.

docs.label: Company response
docs.text:
Response from Vista Customer Care, September 14

Dear Paul,

Thank you for your feedback. We apologize for the difficulty you experienced. Many older homes lack a common wire, and we are updating our installation guide to explain this clearly. If you submit your electrician's receipt through our Web site, we will refund the cost of the service up to $75. We are glad that the thermostat is performing well for you.
